resources.string: Torrents (Telos Downloads and Telos Video) connect only through the selected WireGuard proxy of Telos Network. Telos opens a local HTTP proxy for it, which exists only while Telos Network is on and the proxy is connected. Otherwise torrents wait and nothing connects directly. This replaces the proxy above for torrents. An HTTP proxy carries TCP only, so DHT and uTP are switched off. While it runs, other apps on this device could also use the local proxy.
There is no WireGuard proxy in Telos Network yet.
Torrents use the WireGuard proxy %1$s of Telos Network.
Torrents wait: Telos Network is not running.
Torrents wait: the selected WireGuard proxy no longer exists.
Torrents wait: the selected WireGuard proxy is switched off.
Torrents wait: the selected WireGuard proxy is not connected.
Torrents wait: Telos Network could not open the local proxy.
